candidates.formal_type:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : NeZero.{0} p],
  Eq.{1} (Fintype.card.{0} (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p)) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p 3)

∀ {p : Nat} [NeZero.{0} p] (g : Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p),
  Eq.{1} g
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.xGen p) g.a.val)
        (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.yGen p) g.b.val))
      (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} { a := 0, b := 0, c := 1 } (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} g.c (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} g.a g.b)).val))

∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (z : Complex),
  Eq.{1} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z p) 1 →
    ExistsUnique.{1} fun ρ =>
      And
        (∀ (f : ZMod p → Complex) (t : ZMod p),
          Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.xGen p)) f t)
            (f (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} t 1)))
        (∀ (f : ZMod p → Complex) (t : ZMod p),
          Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.yGen p)) f t)
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z t.val) (f t)))

{p : Nat} →
  [NeZero.{0} p] →
    (z : Complex) →
      Eq.{1} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z p) 1 →
        Representation.{0, 0, 0} Complex (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (ZMod p → Complex)

∀ {p : Nat} (z : Complex) (g : Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (f : ZMod p → Complex) (t : ZMod p),
  Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.rhoLin z g) f t)
    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} g.b t) g.c).val)
      (f (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} t g.a)))
